info.title: DataForge
info.description: Schema validation, submission management, and review workflow API

post.description:
Upload a CSV file, create a submission, and run validation.

Under the gold-anchored model (D19) the caller only supplies the
``data_project_id``; the schema (and version), the gold dataset, and
every other piece of platform context are derived from the parent
DataProject. The submission's identifiers (``primary_id``,
``instance_id``) are not minted here — they're minted at accept time
via the cross-service mint flow (D33).

post.description:
Confirm (optionally renamed) columns coming out of AI schema-matching and run
the first validation pass.

Only valid while status == MATCHING_SCHEMA — i.e. once, right after
upload_submission, before this submission has ever been validated.
column_mapping renames source headers ({source: target}); leave it null
to validate the file as-is (user chose to skip AI mapping entirely).

Upload a corrected file to an existing submission, creating a new version.

Only valid when the submission is in corrections_needed status.
Raises 409 (via InvalidTransitionError handler) for any other status.

Uses the same schema as the original submission.

get.description: Get submission details by ID.
Download the validation report for the latest version.

Validation report grouped by (field, rule, message) with occurrence counts.

Returns errors and warnings separately, each with a grouped summary and a
per-row detail list. Replaces the forge-app api_server proxy that called
this service and re-aggregated the result.

schema.title: Response Get Formatted Report Api V1 Submissions  Submission Id  Report Formatted Get

post.description:
Re-run validation on the current stored file without bumping the version or changing status.

Intended for post-edit re-validation: the caller first updates the file via PUT /file,
then calls this endpoint to get a fresh validation result.

Force-recheck this submission against its gold dataset's *current*
schema version — the manual counterpart to the automatic background
sweep triggered by gold upgrades.

Unlike ``POST /revalidate`` above, this can change submission state: an
ACCEPTED submission that no longer complies gets a corrective revision
cloned (same as the automatic sweep), and a compliant one gets its
``latest_compliant_version`` stamped forward. Runs inline and returns
the outcome immediately rather than relying on a silent background task.

Transition a corrections_needed submission back to pending_review.

Called after the submitter has fixed errors via in-place editing and
revalidation passes.  Idempotent if already in pending_review.
Returns 409 for any other current status.

Withdraw a submission, moving it to a terminal WITHDRAWN state.

Allowed from any non-terminal status except ACCEPTED.
Withdrawn submissions are excluded from active project pipelines.

put.description:
Replace the stored CSV for the current version with an edited file.

Overwrites the file for the current version without triggering
re-validation or a status change. Used by the in-place edit pathway
when the reviewer or submitter fixes errors in the uploaded data
pre-accept; the platform-generated ``primary_id`` / ``instance_id``
columns are added at accept time by the mint flow (D14), not here.

schema.title: Response Update Submission File Api V1 Submissions  Submission Id  File Put

get.description: Download the raw CSV file for the latest submission version.

post.description:
Apply a column-level value mapping to the submission file and resubmit.

Loads the current file from storage, applies the mapping in-process,
and creates a new submission version via the resubmit flow.
mapping format: {column: {raw_value: canonical_value}}

Run harmonization matching on a submission's CSV against its schema CDEs.

Returns per-column mapping suggestions with confidence scores and match tiers.
AI matching runs server-side in registry-service — dataforge governance only.

post.description: Claim a submission for review.
Release a claim on a submission.

Accept a submission and append its data to the target gold dataset.

Under the gold-anchored model every submission attaches to a gold
dataset; the legacy master-append fallback was removed (D40). The
APPEND strategy triggers a cross-service mint call to registry
(D33). REVISION / AUTO_RESOLVE skip the mint and operate on
already-minted gold rows.
Reject a submission with optional notes.

patch.description:
Partial-update a gold dataset's metadata / display fields.

``GoldDataset.metadata`` is never locked (D21). Scheme edits go
through the dedicated ``/identifier-scheme`` sub-resource below.

get.description: Return the current identifier scheme (may be null).

patch.description:
Replace the identifier scheme on a gold dataset.

Status codes:
  * 200 — scheme set successfully (or replaced pre-lock).
  * 404 — gold dataset not found.
  * 409 — scheme is locked by a prior accept (D21, D23).
  * 422 — scheme is internally inconsistent (validate_scheme; D25),
    or a multi-valued metadata key has no matching schema field
    (validate_scheme_against_schema_fields) — best-effort, skipped
    if the schema can't be loaded.

delete.description:
Clear the identifier scheme on a gold dataset.

Returns 409 once the scheme is locked. A cleared scheme reverts the
gold dataset to the "no scheme configured" state — accept attempts
will fail with 409 until a new scheme is configured (D24).

get.description: Return the changelog for a gold dataset, ordered by version ascending.

schema.title: Response List Snapshots Api V1 Gold  Dataset Id  Snapshots Get

post.description:
Validate uploaded CSV against the gold dataset's schema without saving.

Provenance columns (starting with ``_``) are stripped before validation so
they don't cause spurious schema errors.

delete.description:
Delete specific rows from a gold dataset by their identifier column value.

Targeted delete: accepts a list of row IDs, removes matching rows,
writes a snapshot with the required reason. Does not re-run schema
validation — rows were already validated at acceptance time.

schema.title: Response Delete Gold Rows Api V1 Gold  Dataset Id  Rows Delete

get.description:
Paginated, optionally-searched/filtered view of a gold dataset's rows.

Filters server-side before paginating, so the client never needs to hold
more than one page in memory — the full-CSV-download-and-parse approach
this replaces doesn't survive datasets in the ~100k-row range (see
.scratch/table-search/issue-001.md).

schema.description: Case-insensitive substring match across visible columns
schema.title: Search

patch.description:
Apply cell-level edits to specific rows by their identifier column value.

Targeted update, mirroring ``delete_gold_rows``: only the rows that
actually changed are sent, not the whole dataset — required once the
client pages/searches instead of holding the full CSV in memory (see
.scratch/table-search/issue-001.md).

get.description:
Distinct non-blank values of one column, for populating a filter's value picker.

``truncated=True`` means there are more than ``limit`` distinct values —
the caller should treat the list as suggestions, not a complete set.

schema.title: Response Get Gold Column Distinct Values Api V1 Gold  Dataset Id  Columns  Column  Distinct Values Get

get.description:
Export every row matching the current search/filter as a CSV attachment.

WYSIWYG with the filtered table (same row-scoping as ``/rows``) —
deliberately does not apply ``/download``'s schema-compliance filtering
or provenance-stripping, since the point is to export exactly what's
on screen, not a separately-scoped "clean" export.

put.description:
Replace the accumulated gold dataset data with the edited CSV.

Provenance columns for rows that lack them (i.e. newly added rows) are
filled with ``manual_edit`` defaults before saving.

get.description: Download the gold dataset as it was at a specific snapshot version.
Compute a row-level diff between two snapshots of a gold dataset.

schema.description: Optional key column for identity-based diff
schema.title: Key Col

parameters.description: Optional key column for identity-based diff

get.description:
Download the gold dataset as CSV, filtered to schema-compliant rows.

Rows are kept only if their `_latest_compliant_version` meets the
gold dataset's current schema version by (major, minor). All
provenance (`_`-prefixed) columns are stripped from the output —
consumers get schema-valid data only, by default.
Pull the latest schema version from the registry and return upgrade status.

post.description:
Upgrade the gold dataset to a new schema version, cascade UPGRADE_REQUIRED
to contributing DataProjects, and schedule schema re-validation for minor/major bumps.

Patch bumps never enqueue re-validation — per ADR-0004 they are purely
non-structural and cannot change any submission's compliance.

Merge rows from multiple gold datasets into a single target dataset.

All source datasets must share the same schema_id as the target.
Duplicate primary_id values across sources raise HTTP 422.
The merged result is written as a new snapshot on the target.

Create a DataProject attached to an existing gold dataset (D19).

If the caller omits ``metadata`` we snapshot the parent gold
dataset's metadata (D3). Callers may override the snapshot by
supplying a non-empty dict.

get.description: List DataProjects with optional filters, paginated.
Get a DataProject, updating latest_available_version from the registry if needed.

put.description:
Partial-update a DataProject.

Per invariant 3 of the gold-anchored model, ``gold_dataset_id`` is
immutable once set — there is no way to re-attach. ``metadata`` is
rejected with HTTP 409 after the first ID is minted under this DP
(D18).

delete.description: Hard-delete a DataProject. Returns 204 on success, 404 if not found.

get.description: Return schema version status relative to the latest registry version.

post.description: Upgrade a DataProject to a new schema version, clearing upgrade_required.

get.description: List all submissions belonging to this data project.

Return the rows accepted into the gold dataset that originated from this project.

Rows are matched by _submission_id against the project's accepted submissions.
Returns a JSON list of row dicts, or 404 if the project has no linked gold dataset
or no accepted data yet.

post.description:
Upload a CSV with optional column renaming and value remapping, then validate.

Bundles the harmonization apply step with submission creation so React
callers make a single request instead of upload → apply-mapping → resubmit.
column_mapping renames headers; value_mapping remaps cell values.

Mark a DataProject as complete.

Transitions the project status to 'complete'. Notification delivery
to admins/reviewers is handled by the registry-service notification
system — this endpoint records the state change only.

get.description: Service info.
Health check endpoint.

column_mapping.title: Column Mapping
column_mapping.description: JSON dict mapping source column names to schema field names

value_mapping.title: Value Mapping
value_mapping.description: JSON dict {col: {old_value: new_value}} applied after column renaming

ColumnMapping.title: ColumnMapping
ColumnMapping.description:
Schema-column names the mint engine reads on accept.

Defaults to the canonical names introduced by the rename PR
(``entity_id`` / ``source_id`` / ``rep_no``). Override per gold
dataset when the bound schema uses different vocabulary — e.g. a
clinical schema declaring ``subject_id`` / ``sample_id`` / ``visit``.

Only the columns the mint engine *reads* are mapped here; the
provenance columns it *writes* (``primary_id``, ``instance_id``)
stay canonical per D13. Template tokens like ``{rep_no}`` also keep
their literal names — they're tokens, not column references.

source_ids.title: Source Ids
source_ids.description: Gold dataset IDs to merge (in order)

target_id.title: Target Id
target_id.description: Gold dataset to write merged rows into

ConfirmMappingRequest.title: ConfirmMappingRequest
ConfirmMappingRequest.description:
Body for POST /{submission_id}/confirm-mapping.

column_mapping renames source headers to schema field names
({source_column: target_column}) — distinct from ApplyMappingRequest's
``mapping``, which remaps cell values within an already-named column.

CreateGoldDatasetRequest.title: CreateGoldDatasetRequest
CreateGoldDatasetRequest.description:
Create payload for a gold dataset.

``identifier_scheme`` is optional at create time (D24). When omitted
the gold dataset exists and accepts DataProject attachment, but the
first accept attempt fails until a scheme is configured via
``PATCH /api/v1/gold/{id}/identifier-scheme``.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Free-form metadata. Becomes locked after the first ID is minted under this DataProject (D18).

DataProjectCreate.title: DataProjectCreate
DataProjectCreate.description:
Create payload for a DataProject.

Under D19 every DataProject is attached to a GoldDataset at creation;
``gold_dataset_id`` is required. ``metadata`` is copied from
``GoldDataset.metadata`` as a one-time snapshot (D3) — callers may
override at create, but in steady state forge-app passes through what
the gold dataset carries.

DataProjectUpdate.title: DataProjectUpdate
DataProjectUpdate.description:
Partial-update payload for a DataProject.

``metadata`` may be supplied only while ``metadata_locked`` is False;
the service raises ``MetadataLockedError`` once any ID has been
minted (D18), which the route translates to HTTP 409.

DedupConfig.title: DedupConfig
DedupConfig.description:
Duplicate-resolution configuration nested on the identifier scheme.

Match-key shape (``disambiguator_columns`` / ``conflict_columns``)
is carried forward from today's GP2 behaviour per D20; migration to
the spec's ``match_keys`` / ``on_duplicate`` form is a future PR.

The named columns refer to schema column names directly — the
:class:`ColumnMapping` rename only affects the canonical entity /
source / rep_no columns read by the mint engine.

id_column.title: Id Column
id_column.description: Column to match row_ids against (default: instance_id)

scheme_locked.title: Scheme Locked
scheme_locked.description: True once the scheme has been frozen by the first accepted submission (D21). Subsequent edits to identifier_scheme will return HTTP 409.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Visible column names, in dataset order

total_count.title: Total Count
total_count.description: Total rows matching the search filter, before pagination

IdGenConfig.title: IdGenConfig
IdGenConfig.description: How a single identifier (primary_id or instance_id) is generated.

IdGenMethod.title: IdGenMethod
IdGenMethod.description:
Identifier-generation method.

MVP ships ``TEMPLATE`` only. ``UUID`` and ``COMPOSITE`` are reserved
for future PRs and intentionally not enumerated yet so that
introducing them is an additive change.

IdentifierScheme-Input.title: IdentifierScheme
IdentifierScheme-Input.description:
Identifier scheme attached to a ``GoldDataset``.

Locked on first accept per D21: ``primary_id``, ``instance_id``,
``metadata_template``, ``dedup`` and ``column_mapping`` are immutable
thereafter. To use a different scheme, create a new gold dataset
(fork-the-gold-dataset semantics).

IdentifierScheme-Output.title: IdentifierScheme
IdentifierScheme-Output.description:
Identifier scheme attached to a ``GoldDataset``.

Locked on first accept per D21: ``primary_id``, ``instance_id``,
``metadata_template``, ``dedup`` and ``column_mapping`` are immutable
thereafter. To use a different scheme, create a new gold dataset
(fork-the-gold-dataset semantics).

IdentifierSchemeResponse.title: IdentifierSchemeResponse
IdentifierSchemeResponse.description: Read-only response shape for the scheme sub-resource.

RevalidationOutcome.title: RevalidationOutcome
RevalidationOutcome.description:
Per-submission result of a manual or automatic schema re-check.

``validation_summary`` set means it ran — ``.is_valid`` is compliant vs.
corrections-needed, no separate status field needed. ``None`` means it
didn't run at all; ``detail`` says why (skipped, or errored).

match_column.title: Match Column
match_column.description: Match column for revision submissions. Under the gold-anchored model the platform mints ``primary_id`` (and optionally ``instance_id``) at accept time; one of those is the natural match key. This override is retained for revisions against gold datasets whose scheme is not yet configured.

ReviewerRequest.title: ReviewerRequest
ReviewerRequest.description: Request body for review actions requiring a reviewer identity.

version.title: Version
version.description: Sequential snapshot version number, starting at 1

total_rows.title: Total Rows
total_rows.description: Total rows in the dataset after this append

column_count.title: Column Count
column_count.description: Number of columns in the dataset after this snapshot

file_size_bytes.title: File Size Bytes
file_size_bytes.description: Size of the snapshot CSV file in bytes

schema_version.title: Schema Version
schema_version.description: Gold dataset schema version at acceptance time

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional reason or commit message for this change

SnapshotEntry.title: SnapshotEntry
SnapshotEntry.description: A changelog entry recording one accepted submission appended to a gold dataset.

SubmissionResponse.title: SubmissionResponse
SubmissionResponse.description: API response for a single submission.

file_hash.title: File Hash
file_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the uploaded file

validation_result_id.title: Validation Result Id
validation_result_id.description: Reference to stored ValidationResult, set after validation

SubmissionVersion.title: SubmissionVersion
SubmissionVersion.description:
Immutable snapshot of one uploaded file within a submission.

Each time a submitter uploads or re-uploads a file, a new version is
created. Versions are never mutated after creation.

UpdateGoldDatasetRequest.title: UpdateGoldDatasetRequest
UpdateGoldDatasetRequest.description:
Partial-update payload for a gold dataset's mutable fields.

Scheme edits go through the ``/identifier-scheme`` sub-resource —
this endpoint never touches the scheme so its lock semantics stay
surgical.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Each entry must include id_column plus any subset of other columns to change

id_column.title: Id Column
id_column.description: Column identifying which row each entry targets

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional note recorded on the resulting snapshot

UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse
UploadResponse.description:
Response from uploading and validating a submission.

``validation_summary`` is None when the submission is still in
MATCHING_SCHEMA — validation hasn't run yet at that point (see
``upload_submission`` / ``confirm_mapping``).
